info.title: PretasiPlus API contract
info.description: Generated from packages/contract (zod). Do not edit by hand: run `npm run contract:emit`.

Id.description: Opaque entity id (string). Never parse or construct on the client.

ClientUuid.description: Client-generated UUID used as an idempotency key.

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 instant serialised in Malaysia time (+08:00).

TimestampInput.description: ISO 8601 instant with an explicit offset (or Z).

RoleCode.description: Role code. admin = Admin Pusat, school_admin = Admin Sekolah, ppd_officer = Pegawai PPD/JPN, teacher = Guru, student = Murid, parent = Ibu Bapa, sponsor = Penaja.

fields.description: Field name to BM message, for VALIDATION_ERROR.

details.description: Structured extras (e.g. candidate schools for AMBIGUOUS_USERNAME).

retryAfter.description: Seconds until a retry is allowed, for RATE_LIMITED.

label.description: Chip text value, formed by the server (BM).

via.description: mod_pelajar while the student mode is on.

isTest.description: Data written under the mode is stamped is_test.

capabilities.description: Keys from capabilitiesFor(role, scope): <item>.read, plus <item>.write for F/S modes.

schoolId.description: Needed only when a username exists in more than one school.

AuthErrorCode.description: Error codes of the auth and session endpoints, in addition to the generic ones.

AccessRoleModes.description: Access mode per role. A missing key means hidden for that role.

ppdOnly.description: Visible to a PPD (district) officer only, hidden for JPN (state) officers.

prototypeScope.description: D43: true when the item maps to a row of role-access-matrix.md for school_admin (shown in the v2 prototype). False for the admin and ppd_officer views.

items.description: Item labels where the requirements name them.

inV2Prototype.description: D43: the group hosts at least one prototype item of role-access-matrix.md.

labelSource.description: proposed = the doc describes the group but gives no exact copy.

row.description: Row # of role-access-matrix.md section B; 0 = section A.

grade.description: Link to the user grade (1 to 11); null for levels created later.
Link to the user grade (1 to 11); null for levels created later.

icon.description: Free text: Lucide name, Font Awesome class or emoji.
Free text: Lucide name, Font Awesome class or emoji.

strand.description: Unit/strand title kept from .cloud (v2 addition; read-only).

dskpCode.description: Printed DSKP code such as 1.1.3 (v2 addition; read-only).

inTree.description: Display flag set by rule; out-of-tree chapters are never returned.

subjectLabel.description: Subject code with "_" replaced by a space.

practiceUrl.description: null when the topic is locked.

code.description: Stable printed code (1.0, 1.1, 1.1.3); questions tag by id, lookups by code.

post.summary: Log in with e-mail or username and password
post.description: Regenerates the session id and sets the session cookie. The role, scope and capabilities in the returned Session are decided by the server.

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS (never reveals which part was wrong).

403.description: ACCOUNT_INACTIVE or SCHOOL_INACTIVE.

post.description: Idempotent: returns 204 even when there is no session. When a session exists, X-CSRF-Token is checked (403 CSRF_INVALID).

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token

204.description: Logged out, or there was no session. No body.

403.description: CSRF_INVALID.

get.description: One call resolves roles, active role, scope, capabilities, mode and landing path.

post.description: The role must be in the account role list. Scope is never accepted from the client.

post.description: Allowed for admin and school_admin only. The session acts as self (student), data is test data.
